notes.note: Bounded scratch semantics review at 86495c4f24c7: the existing full-backup and update-rollback owner cases now seed private scratch bytes and assert snapshot inclusion/restoration, prior-home retention of later full-restore bytes, and removal of trial-only scratch state during update rollback. The production scratch:state classification is unchanged. Inspected private-folder preparation (0700 and symlink/realpath containment), archive live/external filters, CLI homeReset confirmation/inactive-home lease plus whole-home rename, and portability snapshot reads limited to app config/agents/integrations. Scratch has no separate age-based retention path; home reset archives rather than erases it, and configuration export does not traverse it. All 343 tests passed across registry, archive, update backup, CLI lifecycle/reset and portability owners. Completeness/privacy assertions are preserved. This is a separate classification/consumer audit from beta18 native qualification; no external Windows workspace policy or new retention behavior is introduced.
